Chargers vs Chiefs Betting History

Every Los Angeles Chargers vs Kansas City Chiefs game since the 1966 season: 120 meetings with the final score, the closing point spread, the closing total and how each game graded against both. The Chiefs lead the series 67-53. Against the spread the Chargers are 59-58-3 (Chiefs 58-59-3), the over is 40-53-1, and the Chiefs have outscored the Chargers by 1.8 points a game.
